A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a set of secondary relations to annotate anaphoric relations in the context of elaborations, and that we have shown that the annotation of these secondary relations is feasible.
the anaphora resolution task is a difficult task.
we are able to annotate anaphora in a corpus of German text with high inter-annotator agreement.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the annotation of the anaphoric relations in a corpus can provide useful insights into how language is used to refer.
